string-array.item: Find a stay that fits your story

string-array.name: onboarding_slide_bodies
string-array.item: From mountain cabins to oceanfront villas, roam helps you find unforgettable stays for every kind of trip.
Describe your trip in one sentence, like a quiet cabin with a hot tub, and roam ranks the stays that fit.
Ask about check-in, pets or cancellations and see the stay\'s own rules, word for word, with their source.
